d:
A man attends a party.
Ari and his girlfriend are attending an afternoon party in Hollywood. The people are very nice, the snacks are great, and it's full of well-connected industry professionals, all there to support and cheer on "the director" they know and revere.
But as Ari quickly finds out, this is no ordinary industry event. It's actually the gathering of a cult, and Ari must corral the friends he brought and get out without being sucked in.
